_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the homepage/category titles and H1s — already the dominant brand phrase across every cs/ page. Keep as the default when describing the core Unicode-font job.
phrases.good_example: Ozdobné písmo a stylová písmenka ke zkopírování
phrases.avoid_when: Do not swap for 'hezké písmo' in title/H1 slots — that variant reads more casual/FAQ-register (see CS-002).

phrases.usage_guidance: Good in FAQ questions and casual intro copy ('Kde najdu hezká písmenka ke zkopírování?') where a friendlier register fits better than the marketing-grade 'ozdobné písmo'.
phrases.good_example: Kde najdu hezká písmenka ke zkopírování?
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid in formal/technical FAQ answers (e.g. Discord field-permission tables) where 'ozdobné písmo'/'Unicode znaky' reads more precise.

phrases.usage_guidance: Pairs well with 'ozdobné písmo' in a title (avoids repeating the same word twice) — exactly how the homepage title already uses it.
phrases.good_example: Ozdobné písmo a stylový text ke zkopírování

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the symbols/decorations page — already the page slug and H1.
phrases.good_example: Speciální znaky — Symboly na Kopírování & Znaky do Jména

phrases.english_concept: characters for the name / nickname decoration
phrases.usage_guidance: Use when framing symbols specifically for usernames/nicks rather than bio text in general.
phrases.good_example: Jak použít znaky do jména?

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the nickname-generator page. 'Přezdívka' is the more formal/dictionary synonym and both are used interchangeably on-site and in forums — keep 'nick' as the lead term for gaming-register copy.
phrases.good_example: Generátor přezdívek do her
phrases.avoid_when: In formal/legal copy prefer 'přezdívka' over the loanword 'nick'.

phrases.usage_guidance: The '...ke zkopírování' construction (e.g. 'písmenka ke zkopírování') is the site's standing pattern for titles/H2s; 'Kopírovat' alone is the button label. Both are already correct and idiomatic — keep as-is.
phrases.good_example: Ozdobná písmenka A–Z ke zkopírování

phrases.usage_guidance: Already the site's standing term, linked from multiple pages to /library/invisible-character/. Keep as primary; see CS-009 for a more technical alternate phrasing worth testing in FAQ/meta copy.
phrases.good_example: Trik je použít neviditelný znak (invisible character). Zkopíruj prázdný znak ze stránky Invisible Character.

phrases.english_concept: invisible space / zero-width space (technical alternate phrasing)
phrases.usage_guidance: A legitimate alternate search formulation for the same invisible-character concept the site already covers as 'neviditelný znak'. Consider testing as a secondary H2/FAQ phrasing on /library/invisible-character/ rather than replacing the primary term.
phrases.good_example: Neviditelná mezera neboli zero-width-space odděluje základní tag od jeho skloňované formy.
phrases.avoid_when: Don't use as the primary gaming-register term (CS-008 'neviditelný znak' is more natural for nickname contexts) — 'neviditelná mezera' reads more like a typography/hashtag-formatting explainer.

phrases.usage_guidance: Already the site's standing explanation across nearly every FAQ set ('Proč se ... zobrazují čtverečky?'). Keep as-is — it's the correct, natural, universally-understood term.
phrases.good_example: Proč se někomu zobrazují čtverečky místo písmenek?

phrases.usage_guidance: Central framing device across all three Discord guides and both Instagram/Discord font pages. Keep using this exact pairing — it resolves the single most common support question ('why won't my styled name save?').
phrases.good_example: Uživatelské jméno — tvůj unikátní login... Zobrazované jméno — velké přátelské jméno ukazované na chatu.

phrases.usage_guidance: Already used extensively in the bio page's live-counter FAQ. Good general term; keep pairing it with the specific number per platform.
phrases.good_example: Instagram: 150 znaků pro bio, 30 znaků pro uživatelské jméno

phrases.english_concept: forced rename / disallowed characters (render-safety pain point)
phrases.usage_guidance: This is the verbatim pain point behind JTBD-26 (render-safety checker). Use as source material for a future 'will my styled name get rejected/renamed' FAQ or checker feature — do not present as site copy verbatim since it's an official rule announcement, not marketing language.
phrases.good_example: Po tomto datumu budou na základě stížností nicky se speciálními znaky automaticky měněny podporou.
phrases.avoid_when: Don't generalize this specific Seafight policy as universal — other games/platforms have different (and often less punitive) handling.

phrases.usage_guidance: Too technical/inside-baseball for general site copy — useful only as background for understanding how games communicate character restrictions to players, e.g. in a render-safety FAQ aside.
phrases.good_example: Pro vytváření herních nicků jsou povolené pouze znaky UTF-8.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use in consumer-facing titles/H1s — reads as a developer/support term, not a player term.

phrases.usage_guidance: Useful phrasing for a FAQ answer explaining why shorter/simpler nicknames are recommended, distinct from the platform-imposed 'limit znaků' (CS-012) — this is about usability/memorability, not a hard platform cap.
phrases.good_example: Nechci tak dlouhý nick.

phrases.usage_guidance: Not for direct site copy (too blunt/mocking in tone), but valuable as community-norm context: Czech gamers explicitly look down on both keyboard-mash names and gimmicky leetspeak ('adding a 3'), which supports keeping the site's own generator focused on genuinely distinctive Unicode styling rather than random-character gimmicks.
phrases.good_example: Třísknout do klávesnice a napsat za to CZ, to udělá kdejakej jouda.
phrases.avoid_when: Never use as marketing copy — it's a put-down, not a term to adopt in first-person site voice.

phrases.english_concept: a name nobody else has (uniqueness through styling)
phrases.usage_guidance: Already live, natural copy on the nickname-generator page. Keep as the framing for 'why style + symbols, not just a plain name'.
phrases.good_example: Aby ho nikdo neměl: kombinace jména + stylu písma + symbolu udělá tvůj nick jedinečný.

phrases.usage_guidance: The Czech-ized 'tag klanu' / 'klanová zkratka' construction (seen on gamesites.cz and the sister DarkOrbit CZ/SK board, both real, distinct forums) is the more community-native phrasing than the raw English 'clan tag' the repo currently mixes in mid-sentence on the same page — worth normalizing to Czech phrasing in future copy.
phrases.good_example: Krátké, snadno zapamatovatelné, ideální jako clan tag.
phrases.avoid_when: Don't code-switch to raw English 'clan tag' inside otherwise-Czech sentences when a natural Czech equivalent ('tag klanu') exists.

phrases.usage_guidance: Already live as a section label on the nickname generator; 'pro' and 'old' work as unglossed English loanwords in this register (no natural single-word Czech equivalent carries the same connotation).
phrases.good_example: Jednoduchý čistý styl, typický pro staré účty & profíky.

phrases.usage_guidance: Completely safe, dominant on-site and off-site term — no translation needed or wanted. Note the platform-specific exception: Discord's own field is labelled 'O mně', not 'bio' (see CS-022) — use the platform's actual field name when giving field-by-field instructions.
phrases.good_example: Písmo pro bio: ozdobná písmenka, symboly a šablony do bia
phrases.avoid_when: When referring specifically to Discord's about-me field, use 'O mně' (its actual UI label), not 'bio'.

phrases.english_concept: Discord Nitro (paid tier, unglossed brand/platform term)
phrases.usage_guidance: Never translate — it's a product name. The site correctly uses the 'bez Nitra' (without Nitro) framing repeatedly to differentiate the free Unicode-styling job from Discord's paid Display Name Styles feature.
phrases.good_example: Vše zdarma a bez Nitra.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use this exact UI label when giving Discord-specific field instructions rather than the generic 'bio' — the site already does this correctly and consistently.
phrases.good_example: Discordovo „O mně“ podporuje až 190 znaků plného Unicode.
phrases.avoid_when: Don't substitute the generic 'bio' when specifically instructing where to paste text inside Discord's own settings UI.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use when the desired connotation is dark/intense/aggressive — the site's own copy explicitly pairs gotika with Zalgo for 'herní klany, které chtějí vypadat hrozivě' (clans that want to look intimidating) and separately describes it as 'Temná, výrazná písmena na jméno profilu s charakterem.'
phrases.good_example: Temná, výrazná písmena na jméno profilu s charakterem.
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid pairing with soft/romantic framing (see CS-024 kurzíva for that register instead).

phrases.usage_guidance: Use when the desired connotation is elegant/romantic/soft — repo copy explicitly calls it 'nejoblíbenější do bia na Instagramu' (most popular for Instagram bio) and, alongside kaligrafie, 'elegantní, oblíbená volba pro bio tvůrců'.
phrases.good_example: nejoblíbenější do bia na Instagramu je kurzíva
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid for dark/aggressive gaming-clan framing (see CS-023 gotika instead).

phrases.english_concept: Czech diacritics compatibility with Unicode styles
phrases.usage_guidance: Already a recurring, well-handled FAQ topic across the homepage and both platform pages. Keep the honest framing (works fine for base A–Z, degrades gracefully for diacritics, recommend tučné/kurzíva/monospace for full Czech sentences).
phrases.good_example: Pro celé věty v češtině doporučuju tučné, kurzívu nebo monospace — ty si s naší abecedou poradí nejlíp.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary style-category term; already the site's default 'safest style' recommendation across compatibility/troubleshooting FAQs.
phrases.good_example: Generátor tučného písma

phrases.english_concept: 'stylish font' -- collocation with písmo (font/script) rather than text
phrases.content_surface: already the de facto dominant native phrasing for the head term; confirm cs/ pages already lead with this exact phrasing

phrases.english_concept: the actual native search/complaint formulation Czech users type when diacritics fail to display or type correctly
phrases.content_surface: candidate FAQ-question phrasing for a future diacritics-compatibility FAQ entry ('Proč mi nefunguje diakritika v [platform]?'), pending a Search Console/Semrush volume check

phrases.usage_guidance: Confirmed live, mainstream usage — safe as supporting vocabulary in CS gaming-name copy.
